    Eight tonnes of relief supplies sent to Rasuwa flood-hit areas Eight tonnes of relief supplies have been dispatched overnight to communities affected by the Bhotekoshi River flood in Rasuwa, with the Nepal Army mobilising eight trucks for the delivery.

    GLOF confirmed as the reason for Rasuwa flood The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) has tentatively concluded that the rupture of a Tibetan glacier lake resulted in a massive cross-border flood in Bhotekoshi, Rasuwa, killing uncounted people.
